rulings.restated: Add w2.one over every confirmed w2 entry, within the current person when parent-bound. An unanswered roster is unknown.
rulings.model: The IRS condition is 'had more than one employer for 2025', but the program counts confirmed W-2 entries. The text given does not say that each W-2 entry is a distinct employer, so it cannot confirm the count when one employer issues more than one W-2.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained. The W-2 collection is keyed by employer, and repeated forms from one employer are consolidated into one entry ("Keyed by employer within person; consolidate repeated forms for the same employer explicitly", forms/2025/w2.yaml collection note), so the count of entries is the count of employers that "had more than one employer for 2025" (i1040gi p. 117) asks for. No change to the data.
